qas.question: During the hospitalization from 2174-10-21 to 2174-10-23, why were antibiotics not recommended once the stool viral panel result returned?

qas.question: During the hospitalization from 2174-10-21 to 2174-10-23, why was dronabinol held during the admission and deferred to outpatient discussion?

qas.question: During the hospitalization from 2174-10-21 to 2174-10-23, what home precautions were recommended to reduce transmission risk to household contacts?
qas.answer: Soap-and-water handwashing, surface cleaning, avoid food prep, separate bathroom after symptoms.

qas.question: During the hospitalization from 2174-10-21 to 2174-10-23, what discharge readiness criteria did the doctor emphasize before sending the patient home?
